title: 目標達成の後に・アタシの戦場！

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Spring is here once more. One day, just when I'm about to call an end to Bamboo Memory's training arc…

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Thanks for another FIERY training session!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The time has finally come for us to decide the path Bamboo Memory will take.
choice_data_list: Let's talk about your future races.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Oh! Okay!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I've gleaned a lot from the training she's done up till now. After agonizing over the information, I'm left with only one conclusion.
choice_data_list: I think you should do sprints and miles.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Sprints and miles. As her trainer, I've determined that Bamboo Memory will be at her best running those two distances.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But in the end, that's just what I've decided. None of it means anything if my suggestion doesn't align with what Bamboo Memory wants.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: If she's determined to run in medium and long distances like her friends and take on the Classic Triple Crown tour, then—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Okay, let's do it!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: I can't wait to see how well I'll do in sprints and miles!
choice_data_list: Wait, you're really okay with this?
Wait, you're really okay with this?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Of course I'm okay with it!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: I mean, you believe that's the best way for me to reach the top and make my dream come true, right?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: And I trust you! If you say that's what I should run, then that's what I want to do!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her words and eyes both convey her trust in me, and the uncertainty I felt melts away. But a flicker of doubt remains… does she know what this means?
choice_data_list: If you run sprints and miles, you can't race Yaeno and the others.
If you run sprints and miles, you can't race Yaeno and the others.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I know I could just keep this to myself, but I want Bamboo Memory to make an informed decision—this is her future, after all.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Well… that's what happens when your aptitudes differ. Of course I'd like to run with everyone, but…

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: I don't think now is the time for that.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: No.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Yaeno, Chiyono O, Ardan—everyone has a dream they're striving for!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: And all those dreams are big, bright, and beautiful! It's AWESOME!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Seriously, when I think of them becoming my rivals alongside Oguri, I wanna scream with joy!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Maybe that's why… I think the way I do.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: I came here to meet life-changing rivals and take them on in red-hot, passionate races! If I want to make that a reality…

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: If I want to make my dream come true, I have to become a super awesome, ultra strong racer worthy of Yaeno and the others!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: I know your dream is to make me the strongest Umamusume, and I believe in your dream more than anyone else!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: That's why I'm more than ready to take the skills you see in me and blaze down the path you've chosen!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna sprint all-out down that road because I know it'll lead me right to my dream!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Immediately, I want to live up to the trust she places in me. That desire sets my heart alight, banishing any remaining uncertainty.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I have to communicate that to her. As her trainer, it's my dream to lead her to her dream!
choice_data_list: Let's run in the Swan Stakes.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The Swan Stakes is a 1,400-meter G2 turf race held at Kyoto Racecourse at the end of October.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: This graded sprint is known as the battleground where racers gather to make a name for themselves in miles and sprints.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's the perfect race for Bamboo Memory to test her distance aptitude!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: All right! Time to put everything I've learned to the test! Yaaaaah! I feel like I'm on fire!
choice_data_list: Let's conquer both sprints and miles!
Let's conquer both sprints and miles!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Yeah!
choice_data_list: And let's make you the strongest in this generation!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: YEAH!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: I gonna do it! I'm gonna be the best racer in sprints and miles! And after that…

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: I'll be able to stand alongside everyone in my generation! I'll be right there with my friends and their passionate dreams! That's how I'll reach my red-hot rivals!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: BAMBOO MEMORYYY!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Our next goal race is the Swan Stakes! The next phase of Bamboo Memory's racing career, her classic year, starts now!
